options.description: An object containing the name of the user

options.description: A string containing the name of the user.

options.name: --nick-name
options.description: A string containing an alternate name for the user

options.name: --profile-url

options.description: A list of Email objects containing email addresses associated with the user

options.name: --addresses
options.description: A list of Address objects containing addresses associated with the user

options.name: --phone-numbers

options.name: --user-type

options.name: --title
options.description: A string containing the title of the user.

options.name: --preferred-language
options.description: A string containing the preferred language of the user.

options.name: --locale
options.description: A string containing the geographical region or location of the user

options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.
